## Description

Applies Graph Attention Networks to asset correlation graphs to compute adaptive, non-linear shrinkage covariance matrices for dynamic mean-variance portfolio optimization.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional portfolio optimization, noisy covariance matrix estimation, multi-asset tactical allocation.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Systematic Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental factor panels, sector taxonomies.

## Caveats

Attention weight regularization is necessary to prevent covariance conditioning degradation.
